feeds.title: Fabulous Doodles Fashion Illustration blog by Brooke Hagel
feeds.description: Brooke Hagel is a New York City based fashion illustrator. While studying fashion design at the Fashion Institute of Technology, she began her career as an intern in the wardrobe department of Sex and the City, design studio of Cynthia Rowley, and production offices of Saturday Night Live. Brooke began designing and styling products for Hearst Magazines, contributing to Harper's Bazaar etc.

feeds.title: Willa Gebbie Blog
feeds.description: Willa Gebbie is a Scottish illustrator, working in beauty, fashion and portraiture. She spends her days working from either her Islington studio in London, or her home studio in Berlin. Her illustrations, often of the female figure, use confident line, textured with feminine watercolour and contemporary digital elements.

feeds.title: annasillustrations
feeds.description: Anna Wijnands is a fashion illustrator from Netherlands who loves to draw and design. Her illustrations are inspired by fashion, art, it-girls, Audrey Hepburn, modern-day city life & some good coffee. She uses watercolors, ink, and acrylic paint to make her drawings come to life. Her work covers a broad range of subjects: she can draw anything from a couture gown to beauty items or food products.

feeds.title: Virginia Romo Illustration Blog
feeds.description: This is the blog where Virginia Romo posts her latest illustrations, projects and impressions. Her My work ranges from elegant fashion silhouettes to joyful decoration patterns. I use pencil, ink and watercolours when working at my drawing table and programs like Photoshop, Illustrator or Manga Studio when I work on my Cintiq.

feeds.title: Joanna Baker : Fashion & Lifestyle Illustrations Blog
feeds.description: My name is Joanna and I'm a fulltime freelance illustrator and designer living in New York City with my husband and our cat Junebug. In January of 2015 I finally decided to make the leap and pursue my freelance work full time. I am now putting my energy towards freelance illustration and design projects in addition to building my own brand of illustrated paper goods and art prints.

feeds.title: Final Fashion
feeds.description: My name is Danielle Meder, I am a fashion artist and writer. As an illustrator, I specialize in sketching live at fashion shows, creating complex layered paper dolls, and helping fashion designers communicate their ideas. The theme of my writing is the ephemeral nature of fashion, beauty and fame. I am a regular contributor to the Style section of Canada's national newspaper The Globe and Mail.

feeds.title: Hayden Williams Fashion Illustrations
feeds.description: Hayden Williams is a British Fashion Illustrator & Designer. Conquering the world one fashion sketch at a time.

feeds.title: Chic Sketch Blog
feeds.description: Chic Sketch is a mobile fashion application and live events service that transforms your look into a real fashion illustration. Chic Sketch delivers an insider view into the world of fashion. Discover fashion sketching, live events, and this hottest season's trends.

feeds.title: M A N J I T T H A P P
feeds.description: I'm Manjit Thapp and I am an illustrator based in the UK.I studied BA Illustration from Camberwell College of Arts.

feeds.title: Fashion Illustration Tribe Blog
feeds.description: Laura Volpintesta has been teaching since 1997 (BFA Fashion pattern/draping/sewing) and since 2000 (AAS Fashion drawing, design, portfolio). Laura Volpintesta creates and guides online fashion art and drawing courses to foster 'fashion in our own image': fashion and portfolio courses that offer an alternative to expensive, university programs by encouraging study from home.

feeds.title: Fifi Lapin
feeds.description: I'm Fifi Lapin. I'm an hare-ss to my fathers fortune which he made playing fast and loose with carrot and lettuce shares on the international stock market. There are a lot of rabbits out there eating carrots and lettuce so I guess he just struck gold (or orange you might say). Some people think I'm just a social butterfly but I think there is more to me than just an extremely stylish clotheshorse.

feeds.title: Elaine Biss Blog
feeds.description: Elaine Biss is a fashion event illustrator with over 10 years of experience. She specializes in live sketching retail events, book illustrations, social media content, brush calligraphy and accessory customization that cater to the female buyer.

feeds.title: Grace Ciao Blog
feeds.description: Grace Ciao is known for delicate and luxurious illustrations with flowers and watercolors. She's available for live sketching, art commissions and licensing.

feeds.title: Travel Write Draw
feeds.description: My name is Meagan Morrison and I'm a Toronto-raised, New York-based, traveling fashion illustrator. I started TWD back in September 2010 and it has since become my pipe dream willed into reality. It documents my adventures across the globe, and here in New York, with illustrations created through a fashion-art lens.

feeds.title: Jacqueline Bissett
feeds.description: Jacqueline Bissett has over 30 years of experience in the fashion illustration industry. Specialising in live drawing events, commissions for both private and corporate clients, Jacqueline has worked with some of the most well known brands both nationally and internationally. Jacqueline has become known as an expert in the field of hand rendered fashion illustrations.

feeds.title: Unskilled Worker
feeds.description: Unskilled Worker is a London-based, self-taught artist who rose to prominence via her wildly successful Instagram account.

feeds.title: Fashion Illustration by Rongrong DeVoe Blog
feeds.description: Rongrong DeVoe is an international freelance fashion illustrator based in Houston, TX, US. Serving New York, London, Paris and worldwide. In this blog you will see the latest updates of her fashion illustration projects, my illustration commissions, my fashion illustration tutorials and fashion events.

feeds.title: Michelle Baron
feeds.description: A place for inspiration, sketches, and illustration by Michelle Baron. I'm an illustrator who loves monograms, hand written notes, sailor stripes, silk dresses, and all things about fashion. I'm a freelancer, working from home, and looking for inspiration in everything.

feeds.title: HUNGRY VOID
feeds.description: HUNGRY VOID is a fashion blog, based in London, mainly focused on fashion illustration and fashion photography by Francesco LO IACONO.

feeds.title: Olesja's Fashion Illustration
feeds.description: I'm Olesja Hännikäinen. I am a Helsinki based fashion illustrator with passion for haute couture and other beautiful things.

feeds.title: The Architect of Style
feeds.description: Gissi Jimenez is the head editor & fashion illustrator for The Architect of Style. Gissi's has collaborated and made illustrations for beauty and fashion brands Bloomingdale's, CHANEL, Dolce and Gabanna, Saks, Macy's, Charriol Jewlery, Covergirl, Victoria's Secret & Mia Shoes, doing special collaborations with fashion illustrations for events and their social media.

feeds.title: Other Wardrobe by Leni Kauffman
feeds.description: Other Wardrobe, a weekly illustrated fashion blog by Leni Kauffman. She is an illustrator of American and Japanese heritage currently living and working in London. She works in Pencil, Watercolour and Ink as well as digitally.

feeds.title: Poppy Waddilove
feeds.description: Poppy Waddilove is a London Based Fashion Illustrator represented by IMG Models.

feeds.title: Fashion illustrations by Armand Mehidri
feeds.description: Armand Mehidri is a Fashion Illustrator. He creates fashion illustrations about his favorite celebrities.

feeds.title: Michael Hoeweler
feeds.description: Michael Hoeweler was born and raised along the outskirts of Cincinnati, Ohio. After a youth spent exploring the Midwestern landscape of cornfields and suburban expanses, he left for Baltimore, Maryland, where he graduated with a BFA in illustration from the Maryland Institute College of Art.

feeds.title: PAM & PEA
feeds.description: Hi my name is Pam. Drawing to escape the bore that is life. All drawings are my own.

feeds.title: Sainte Maria Illustration
feeds.description: My name is Maria and I'm illustrator and graphic designer from Russia. Art, fashion, garments and design are my passion and a big part of my life!

feeds.title: ShellSherree Blog
feeds.description: Shell Sherree whimsical illustrations, studio life and interviews. Happy ink and watercolour inspired by Paris, cats, dogs, fashion, fluffballs.

feeds.title: I Draw Fashion
feeds.description: Free fashion templates, drawing tips and tutorials for beginners and experienced designers, artists and beauty fans.

feeds.title: Mida Illustrations
feeds.description: Mida Illustrations is a Fashion illustrations blog with digital Art.

feeds.title: Tiffani Anderson Illustration
feeds.description: Tiffani Anderson Illustration is a fashion illustration creations done by Tiffani Anderson.

feeds.title: Linda Byrne Illustration
feeds.description: Linda Byrne is an award winning fashion illustrator who is inspired by people, fashion, art & travel. Originally trained as a classical animator, she chose to specialise her drawing skills towards the fashion industry. Her illustrations revolve around whimsical style & beauty.

feeds.title: Patsyfox
feeds.description: I'm a Melbourne-based fashion illustrator and have been working in the fashion industry since graduating from university in the late 80's. I made the switch to full-time illustration. Besides keeping up with Patsyfox.com, I mix freelance work with teaching fashion illustration at RMIT and in my own boutique classes at The Patsyfox Drawing Salon.

feeds.title: Maggie Ai Fashion Illustration
feeds.description: China-based Fashion Illustrator, Blogger.
